Tailwind: rounded-lg shadow-md p-4 flex items-center gap-4."},{"path":"src/components/UserList.tsx","action":"create","description":"Responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4) of UserCard components. Remove inline User interface and fetch calls entirely."}],"dependencies":["hooks","components"],"description":"Refactor App.tsx to be a thin composition layer. Modal is cleaner UX but adds complexity. Avatar is an optional URL string field. File upload requires significant backend work out of scope. Tailwind card: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-4 flex items-center gap-4."},{"name":"UserList","description":"Responsive grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4) of UserCard components. Inline red error messages below invalid fields.
